title: Remote exact-read summary drops the explicit no-wake statement for a settled delivery with no wake observation
outcome: A remote exact read whose cause carries no wake observation, such as 'mailbox delivery settled' from a routing-only delivery, still states that no remote wake was recorded; a test covers that branch. Found by review of combo24 at src/federation_mailbox_operations.rs:263.
acceptance: Remote exact-read summary drops the explicit no-wake statement for a settled delivery with no wake observation is done
